import csv, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
site = pathlib.Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example').resolve()
prospect = pathlib.Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue')
destination = prospect / 'barcode-control.json'
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def columns(path):
    with path.open(encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as source:
        return set(next(csv.reader(source), []))
def exactly_one(paths):
    if len(paths) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f'Expected one documented fixture or entry point, found {paths}')
    return paths[0]
result = {'scope': 'Fictional files only. No Shopify import, buyer contact, delivery, order or settlement.'}
try:
    draft = prospect / 'operator-draft.md'
    result['draft_sha256'] = sha(draft)
    result['draft_identifier_lines'] = [line for line in draft.read_text().splitlines() if any(term in line.casefold() for term in ('identifi', 'barcode', 'sku', 'barres'))]
    verifier = exactly_one(sorted(site.rglob('verify_example.py')))
    candidates = sorted(site.rglob('*.csv'))
    variants = exactly_one([p for p in candidates if {'style_id','sku','barcode','price'} <= columns(p)])
    images = exactly_one([p for p in candidates if {'style_id','color','position','url'} <= columns(p)])
    output = exactly_one([p for p in candidates if {'Handle','Variant SKU','Variant Barcode'} <= columns(p)])
    result['inputs'] = {str(p.relative_to(site)): sha(p) for p in (verifier, variants, images, output)}
    def run(candidate):
        argv = [sys.executable, str(verifier), str(variants), str(images), str(candidate)]
        process = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=site, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        return {'argv': argv, 'exit': process.returncode, 'stdout': process.stdout, 'stderr': process.stderr}
    result['baseline'] = run(output)
    text = output.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text))
    row = next(r for r in reader if r['Variant Barcode'])
    old = row['Variant Barcode']
    new = '9999999999999'
    if text.count(old) != 1 or new in text:
        raise ValueError('The chosen barcode does not permit a unique byte-preserving replacement')
    mutated = text.replace(old, new, 1)
    before = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))
    after = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(mutated)))
    differences = [(i, j, a, b) for i, (left, right) in enumerate(zip(before, after), 1) for j, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(left, right)) if a != b]
    if len(before) != len(after) or any(len(a) != len(b) for a, b in zip(before, after)) or len(differences) != 1 or before[0][differences[0][1]] != 'Variant Barcode':
        raise ValueError('CSV comparison does not prove exactly one barcode cell changed')
    result['changed_cell'] = {'record': differences[0][0], 'field': 'Variant Barcode', 'before': old, 'after': new}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        changed = pathlib.Path(directory) / output.name
        changed.write_bytes(mutated.encode('utf-8'))
        result['mutated_sha256'] = sha(changed)
        result['negative'] = run(changed)
    expected = 'identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price'
    baseline_failed = json.loads(result['baseline']['stdout'])['failed']
    negative_failed = json.loads(result['negative']['stdout'])['failed']
    result['failed_checks'] = {'baseline': baseline_failed, 'negative': negative_failed}
    result['control_passed'] = result['baseline']['exit'] == 0 and baseline_failed == [] and result['negative']['exit'] == 1 and negative_failed == [expected]
    result['operator_interpretation'] = 'The verifier reports a grouped identifier-preservation failure. Use a source/output row comparison to locate and name the changed field. This test covers one barcode alteration with both input and transformed CSV available.'
except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, StopIteration, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
    result['control_passed'] = False
    result['evidence_gap'] = str(error)
destination.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(destination.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

The next step is to verify that changing one barcode makes the same verifier reject the output, then bind the result to the exact unsent draft. Stream Commerce’s published migration services support workflow fit. Its interest in subcontracting remains unknown.
